subject: First-person gun angle and shots during slides, by slide direction
method: Injected LocalScript in a throwaway copy of the range in Studio, using the movement and combat probes for input. Gun angle is the barrel direction against the view direction, sampled per frame during FirstPersonAction == Slide.

shots_after_fix.full_charge_released_in_slide: left, right, forward, back-left, back-right and back: launch 0.00 studs from the visible gun, 0.00 studs to the side of the crosshair's line, speed 115
shots_after_fix.standing_control: 0.00 studs from the gun, 0.00 to the side
shots_after_fix.tap_in_right_slide: 0.48 studs to the side, speed 65, level 1 (only partly corrected by design)

limits: Scripted input in one Studio session with the camera held level; no real mouse or controller play.
The full-charge worst of 42 degrees is sampled after release, so it probably includes the shot's kick; this was not separated.
The not-charging means include frame 0, still the running arm pump, up to about 120 degrees in every direction including forward.
The not-charging figures are from the build just before the final settle change, which only affects aiming.
A charge held past the slide's end was traced before that settle change: 10 degrees easing to 3 with no pop. The later run's after-slide worst of 39 degrees includes its shot.
First person only. Third-person slides were not changed or measured.
